summary: # Code Quality Rules ## Scope Control Flag changes that expand beyond the requested feature or review scope: - Repo-wide cleanup mixed into a targeted fix. - Compatibility exports, aliases, shims, or wrapper layers added without an explicit migration requirement. - Shared abstractions created before there is stable cross-feature reuse. - Business components moved into generic shared locations without a clear ownership boundary. ## TypeScript Flag: - `any` or broad `Record<string, any>` where generated/API types or local domain types exist.
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
